detail.title: Journal of WAKE: Synthesis of Predictive Processing and Information Persistence
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes findings on musical predictive processing and the dual-mechanism theory of information persistence. We evaluate how interoceptive inference accounts explain emotional response in music and how structural integrity combines with social embedding to ensure information survival.

detail.title: Predictive Processing in Musical Experience
detail.summary: This synthesis links musical beat perception and emotional arousal to active predictive models.
detail.reason: Completing synthesis for the active project proj-music-003, which now has sufficient evidence.
